text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is biting back! There
she stands
before the steps to the
international stage!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
You can do it Nakayama Festa! Just a
little more!
The title is just within your
grasp!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa finishes in second
place! Is this
the brutality of the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(One more step... if I had the strength to
push
forward one more step...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch. No way, I was just dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hard at work at my computer in my
room, I slowly
whittle down the potential
places to stay during
our trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're looking for a place with a training
facility
nearby that would be accessible
to short-term
guests.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to using the simulator, I'm able
to make
some very concrete plans.
choice_data_list: （VRウマレーターの効果は大きかった）

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Sorry for intruding, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A reply came in for your request to do
joint
training with the renowned trainer
from France.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the document from Tazuna and
read the
response.
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't feel too bad. It seems to be very
rare that
requests such as this are
accepted.
choice_data_list: ……ダメだったみたいです

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, this has been the twentieth or
so
request I've had declined.
choice_data_list: ですね。また別の方に依頼してみます

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They probably see me as just some
nobody.
Without a proven track record,
it really isn't a
wonder I'm getting turned
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to do whatever I can to help
Nakayama
Festa so that she can be fully
prepared by the
end of the year.
choice_data_list: （だけどくよくよしていられない）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sit at my desk watching replays of past
Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe races.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A challenger has appeared from the
outside!
They're neck and neck! Can she
break away? Yes,
she's taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My studies reveal the extent of the gap
we'll be
attempting to bridge. How far
will our efforts
take us?
choice_data_list: （あんな芝で軽々と加速できるなんて）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more I learn, the more distant our
goals seem
to become.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Eating something sweet helps when
you're feeling
tired.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There are chocolates inside. I got some
for myself
and figured I'd grab a few
extra for you.
choice_data_list: ……え？ありがとう？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Anyway... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You know that I'm going to the Arc. But
maybe
you're not aware how I'll be
coming back a
winner.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Good. I'm glad you understand.
choice_data_list: ああ、わかってる
うん、わかってる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take out a chocolate from the bag. This
should
help rekindle my spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate packaging reads, "A calm
evening
and a relaxing moment, all in
one little piece."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I stop Nakayama Festa to
have a
quick word with her before
training.
choice_data_list: ……これを自分の分のついでに買ったんだ

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What's this? A thank-you for the
Valentine's gift?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A slight pretext for giving her the gift I
already
had prepared.
choice_data_list: この前、チョコくれただろ？
この前、チョコくれたでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What's this? A heated eye mask?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hmm.
choice_data_list: ああ、寝る前に使ってみて
うん、寝る前に使ってみて

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're not just going to tell me to take
it easy?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Probably not, no.
choice_data_list: そう言っても、今は聞かないだろう？
そう言っても、今は聞かないでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess we're both trying our hardest.
Then, I'll
thankfully accept your gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Nakayama Festa's face
seems to be
ever so slightly less pale
than the day before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A thank-you for the Valentine's
gift?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not entirely to thank her. I make the

suggestion hoping to afford her a
moment of
peace to relax. However...
choice_data_list: ああ、なんでも食べたいものを言ってくれ
うん、なんでも食べたいものを言って

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay, I wanna eat rice porridge then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nah, just porridge.
choice_data_list: お、おかゆ！？寿司とかじゃなくてか！？
お、おかゆ！？寿司とかじゃなくて！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be more tired than I'd
realized. That
evening, I hurriedly
prepare some rice porridge
and take it
to her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You actually made some.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You really are a do-gooder down to the core.
choice_data_list: 当然だよ、お礼なんだから

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the grub.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The flavor was really gentle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Man. The two of you really are alike.
choice_data_list: 体をいたわることを考えて

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm hitting the hay. Busy day tomorrow,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Sure, you too.
choice_data_list: いい夢が見られるといいな
いい夢が見られるといいね

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I completely forgot what I dreamed
about that
evening.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But I slept soundly right through to the
morning,
so it must've been a good one.
